trial_court: Court of ACJM Deoband Saharanpur, Case No. 575 of 2004
case_name: Narendra Kumar And Othes vs State Of U.P. And Another

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Narendra Kumar And Others (husband and others)
parties.respondent_defendant: State Of U.P. And Another (wife and another)

facts_of_case: Complaint case filed under Section 406 IPC by Smt. Kusum against Narendra Kumar and others. The parties have entered into compromise and settled their dispute outside the court.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can amicably settle their disputes outside the court.
legal_principles.held: The parties have entered into compromise and settled their dispute outside the court.
cited_cases: B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana and another, reported in 2003 (46) A.C.C. 779 S.C.

legal_principles.principle: Courts can quash proceedings if parties have amicably settled their disputes.
legal_principles.held: The Apex Court quashed the proceedings of criminal cases in view of the compromise and settlement between the parties.
cited_cases: Narendra Kumar And Othes vs State Of U.P. And Another on 1 February, 2010
Ruchi Agrawal Vs. Amit Kumar Agrawal and others, reported in 2004 (3) J.I.C. 769 S.C.

outcome.final_order: The proceedings of Complaint Case No. 575 of 2004 are quashed as no lawful purpose would be served by continuance of the proceedings between the parties.

use_for_drafting: obtaining stay orders in criminal cases
